turn.user_message: Who at the bed desk would see this?
turn.context: From Automations au-07. Bed Management §7.4.2 to §7.4.4: the peer roles and what passes between the two desks.

text: The bed desk sees it through its own Bed Manager, a peer of the Discharge Manager. Both report to your Head of Operations.
Whether you need a Bed Manager depends on three numbers we do not have yet. So that chair stays open for now.
bullets: Likely discharges reach the bed desk a day ahead.
A 5 PM round confirms tomorrow’s leavers.
Each bill is held against the bed, so the empty time can be measured.
chat.pointer: Pick a hand-over between the two desks to see what it takes.
chat.note: The bed desk plans from the discharge desk’s times.

blocks.eyebrow: Beyond the ward · the bed desk
blocks.title: Two desks, one head
blocks.deck: The discharge desk and the bed desk as peers. What passes between them, and who is needed.

reports_to.name: Head of Operations
reports_to.does: Approves how the two desks work together

roles.name: Discharge Manager
roles.does: Owns discharges. Sends likely leavers to the bed desk a day ahead.

roles.name: Bed Manager
roles.does: Owns bed planning. Places each admission in a bed before it is free.

triggers.label: More admissions than beds free the night before
More than half of admissions late

roles.name: Admissions Executives
roles.does: At least one each shift at 250 beds. Each handles up to 5 admissions an hour.
roles.note: Your busiest admission hour decides if more are needed.

blocks.between_label: What passes between the two desks

between.title: Likely leavers a day ahead
between.detail: Ward patients are flagged 24 hours ahead. Intensive care patients by 1 PM. The bed desk maps beds from this list.

between.title: A 5 PM round
between.detail: The senior doctors check tomorrow’s likely leavers by 5 PM. The bed desk then fixes its plan at 6 PM.

between.title: Bed ready, the minute it is clean
between.detail: Housekeeping marks the bed clean. The bed desk sees it at once, with no phone call.

between.title: Bills held against the bed
between.detail: One patient’s final bill and the next patient’s first bill are read off the same bed. So empty time becomes a number.

between.title: One team, or two?
between.detail: If one team runs discharges and admissions, the two must run side by side. Not one after the other.
